{{Quote|Rumor has it the wreckage of pilot Ched Varga's Y-wing is still visible in an ice lake there. I will say no more.|MK-09, on the dangers of the pilot proving grounds|<ref name="OSG">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>}}
'''Ched Varga''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and became noted as a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Rebel pilots at that [[Time/Legends|time]] frequently tested their skills in the unofficial "[[pilot proving grounds]]," competing to set the best time on a series of courses through a Rebel [[Salvage Yard|salvage yard]] hidden in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]].<ref name="XWA" /> At some point prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Varga was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a crash while flying a course that saw pilots negotiate a figure-eight comprising a series of rings and tunnels that intersected above a frozen [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]] lake in a [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] at the center of a large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].<ref name="XWA" />

The wreckage of Varga's Y-wing was still in the cavern when pilot [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] undertook the same challenge<ref name="XWA" /> in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> Azzameen's [[MK-series maintenance droid]], [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], cited his death as an example of the dangers of the pilot proving grounds.<ref name="OSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This is an even more challenging version of the previous ringed courses. In addition to the rings, you will be flying through asteroid caverns and over the frozen nitrogen lake where the famous Y-Wing pilot, Ched Varga, met his doom.|Description of "Crazy Eight" from the X-Wing Alliance mission file|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:ChedVarga-XWA.png|thumb|right|200px|Ched Varga's wrecked Y-wing]]
Ched Varga was created for the [[1999]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''. The wreckage of a crashed Y-wing can be seen in the pilot proving grounds scenario "Crazy Eight." The pilot of the fighter is not named in the description of the training scenario shown in the game,<ref name="XWA" /> but was identified as Ched Varga in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]''.<ref name="OSG" /> The game's mission file for the scenario also contains a more detailed description that includes Varga's name and death while attempting the course.<ref name="XWA" />
